description: The four tarot suits explained: wands, cups, swords and pentacles, their elements and themes, and how the suits can shape what you notice in a spread.
lede: A tarot deck has four suits, each linked to an element and an area of life. Knowing them helps you read a spread at a glance.

suits.alt: Four panels, one per tarot suit, each with a gold suit icon, the suit name, its element and its themes. Wands: fire, energy and action. Cups: water, feelings and relationships. Swords: air, thought and communication. Pentacles: earth, work and the practical world.
suits.caption: Each suit pairs an element with an area of life. Conventions vary slightly between decks.
